_description: The n-gram token encoding every driver and the metrics dashboard share. A key is a run of tokens: one marker of this closed list, the escape literal_bracket for a typed '[', or one character. Spellings in aliases are older ones still present in raw events; each is read as its canonical marker. Change this file, then run tools/codegen/codegen-keystats-tokens.cjs; bump version and each driver's derived-data revision when a stored key would read differently.
